<description>
SignPSBTInput() checked existing signatures against an assumed sighash type when neither PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE nor the sighashtype parameter was given: SIGHASH_DEFAULT for taproot, SIGHASH_ALL otherwise. A PSBT holding a valid 65-byte SIGHASH_ALL taproot signature could then be neither finalized nor signed further.

BIP 174 lets a signer use any sighash type when the field is absent, so the check now runs only when the field or the parameter is given, for every input type. Without the field, RemoveUnnecessaryTransactions() now also looks at the taproot signatures for SIGHASH_ANYONECANPAY, so that the non_witness_utxo is kept. A functional test in rpc_psbt.py covers a taproot input signed with ALL, NONE and ALL|ANYONECANPAY without the field. A second commit also keeps the non_witness_utxo of a finalized taproot input, whose signatures are left only in the final witness, and tests it on a key path and a script path.

Fixes #36507.
</description>

<commits>
227884d5d9 psbt: check sig sighash only if a type is given

SignPSBTInput() checks that existing signatures use the input's sighash
type. When neither PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE nor the sighash_type parameter
was given, it checked them against an assumed default: SIGHASH_DEFAULT
for taproot, SIGHASH_ALL otherwise. A PSBT holding a valid 65-byte
SIGHASH_ALL taproot signature could then be neither finalized nor
signed further.

BIP 174 lets a signer use any sighash type when the field is absent,
and asks a finalizer to fail on a mismatch only when it is present. So
run the check only when the field or the parameter is given. This also
lets non-taproot partial signatures use any sighash type in that case.

RemoveUnnecessaryTransactions() looked only at the field to find
SIGHASH_ANYONECANPAY. Without the field, also look at the taproot
signatures, so that the non_witness_utxo is kept when one of them uses
it.

Fixes #36507.

f169a27f3a psbt: look at final witness signatures for ANYONECANPAY

A finalized input is serialized without its sighash type field and its
taproot signatures, so RemoveUnnecessaryTransactions dropped the
non_witness_utxos once a PSBT with a finalized ANYONECANPAY taproot
input was processed again, for example by utxoupdatepsbt or
walletprocesspsbt.

Also check the signatures in the final witness, which are among the
items left once the annex and, for a script path, the script and the
control block are removed. A control block can be 65 bytes long and end
with a byte that has 0x80 set, so it is not read as a signature.
</commits>

     }
 
-    // Check all existing signatures use the sighash type
-    if (sighash == SIGHASH_DEFAULT) {
-        if (!input.m_tap_key_sig.empty() && input.m_tap_key_sig.size() != 64) {
-            return util::Unexpected{PSBTError::SIGHASH_MISMATCH};

-            return util::Unexpected{PSBTError::SIGHASH_MISMATCH};
-        }
-        for (const auto& [_, sig] : input.m_tap_script_sigs) {
-            if (sig.size() != 65 || sig.back() != sighash) return util::Unexpected{PSBTError::SIGHASH_MISMATCH};
-        }
-        for (const auto& [_, sig] : input.partial_sigs) {
-            if (sig.second.back() != sighash) return util::Unexpected{PSBTError::SIGHASH_MISMATCH};
+    // Check all existing signatures use the sighash type, if the field or the parameter provides one.
+    // Without either, BIP 174 lets each signer choose its sighash type.
+    if (options.sighash_type || input.sighash_type) {
+        if (sighash == SIGHASH_DEFAULT) {
+            if (!input.m_tap_key_sig.empty() && input.m_tap_key_sig.size() != 64) {
+                return util::Unexpected{PSBTError::SIGHASH_MISMATCH};
+            }
+            for (const auto& [_, sig] : input.m_tap_script_sigs) {
+                if (sig.size() != 64) return util::Unexpected{PSBTError::SIGHASH_MISMATCH};
+            }
+        } else {
+            if (!input.m_tap_key_sig.empty() && (input.m_tap_key_sig.size() != 65 || input.m_tap_key_sig.back() != sighash)) {
+                return util::Unexpected{PSBTError::SIGHASH_MISMATCH};
+            }
+            for (const auto& [_, sig] : input.m_tap_script_sigs) {
+                if (sig.size() != 65 || sig.back() != sighash) return util::Unexpected{PSBTError::SIGHASH_MISMATCH};
+            }
+            for (const auto& [_, sig] : input.partial_sigs) {
+                if (sig.second.back() != sighash) return util::Unexpected{PSBTError::SIGHASH_MISMATCH};
+            }
         }
     }
 
@@ -776,9 +782,18 @@ void RemoveUnnecessaryTransactions(PartiallySignedTransaction& psbtx)
             break;
         }
         // non_witness_utxos cannot be dropped if the sighash type includes SIGHASH_ANYONECANPAY
-        // Since callers should have called SignPSBTInput which updates the sighash type in the PSBT, we only
-        // need to look at that field. If it is not present, then we can assume SIGHASH_DEFAULT or SIGHASH_ALL.
-        if (input.sighash_type != std::nullopt && (*input.sighash_type & 0x80) == SIGHASH_ANYONECANPAY) {
+        // Callers should have called SignPSBTInput, which sets the sighash type field when one was requested.
+        // Without the field, existing signatures may use any sighash type, so also look at the taproot signatures.
+        const auto is_acp{[](const std::vector<unsigned char>& sig) { return sig.size() == 65 && (sig.back() & 0x80) == SIGHASH_ANYONECANPAY; }};
+        // A finalized input has only its final witness: its signatures are among the items left once the annex
+        // and, for a script path, the script and the control block are removed.
+        std::span<const std::vector<unsigned char>> final_sigs{input.final_script_witness.stack};
+        if (final_sigs.size() >= 2 && !final_sigs.back().empty() && final_sigs.back()[0] == ANNEX_TAG) final_sigs = final_sigs.first(final_sigs.size() - 1);
+        if (final_sigs.size() >= 2) final_sigs = final_sigs.first(final_sigs.size() - 2);
+        if ((input.sighash_type != std::nullopt && (*input.sighash_type & 0x80) == SIGHASH_ANYONECANPAY) ||
+            is_acp(input.m_tap_key_sig) ||
+            std::ranges::any_of(input.m_tap_script_sigs, [&](const auto& entry) { return is_acp(entry.second); }) ||
+            std::ranges::any_of(final_sigs, is_acp)) {
             to_drop.clear();
             break;
         }

         wallet.unloadwallet()
 
+    def test_taproot_sighash_field_absent(self):
+        self.log.info("Test that a taproot input without a sighash field accepts signatures of other sighash types")
+        node = self.nodes[0]
+        privkey1, pubkey1 = generate_keypair(wif=True)
+        privkey2, pubkey2 = generate_keypair(wif=True)
+        desc = "tr({},multi_a(2,{},{}))"
+        signer1 = descsum_create(desc.format(H_POINT, privkey1, pubkey2.hex()))
+        signer2 = descsum_create(desc.format(H_POINT, pubkey1.hex(), privkey2))
+        addr = node.deriveaddresses(descsum_create(desc.format(H_POINT, pubkey1.hex(), pubkey2.hex())))[0]
+
+        for sighash in ["ALL", "NONE", "ALL|ANYONECANPAY"]:
+            self.log.info(f"The first signer uses {sighash}, then the sighash field is removed")
+            utxo = self.create_outpoints(node, outputs=[{addr: 1}])[0]
+            psbt = node.createpsbt([utxo], [{addr: 0.9999}])
+            psbt = node.descriptorprocesspsbt(psbt=psbt, descriptors=[signer1], sighashtype=sighash, finalize=False)["psbt"]
+            assert_equal(len(node.decodepsbt(psbt)["inputs"][0]["taproot_script_path_sigs"][0]["sig"]), 65 * 2)
+            mod_psbt = PSBT.from_base64(psbt)
+            del mod_psbt.i[0].map[PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE]
+            mod_psbt.i[0].map[PSBT_IN_NON_WITNESS_UTXO] = bytes.fromhex(node.getrawtransaction(utxo["txid"]))
+            psbt = mod_psbt.to_base64()
+
+            self.log.info("Asking for SIGHASH_DEFAULT rejects the signature")
+            assert_raises_rpc_error(-22, "Specified sighash value does not match value stored in PSBT", node.descriptorprocesspsbt, psbt=psbt, descriptors=[signer2], sighashtype="DEFAULT")
+
+            self.log.info("Without a sighash type, the second signer signs, and the previous transaction is kept only for ANYONECANPAY")
+            signed = node.descriptorprocesspsbt(psbt=psbt, descriptors=[signer2], finalize=False)["psbt"]
+            assert_equal("non_witness_utxo" in node.decodepsbt(signed)["inputs"][0], sighash == "ALL|ANYONECANPAY")
+            res = node.finalizepsbt(signed)
+            assert_equal(res["complete"], True)
+            assert_equal(node.testmempoolaccept([res["hex"]])[0]["allowed"], True)
+
+        self.log.info("A sighash field set to SIGHASH_DEFAULT still rejects the ANYONECANPAY signature")
+        mod_psbt = PSBT.from_base64(psbt)
+        mod_psbt.i[0].map[PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE] = (0).to_bytes(4, byteorder="little")
+        psbt = mod_psbt.to_base64()
+        assert_raises_rpc_error(-22, "Specified sighash value does not match value stored in PSBT", node.descriptorprocesspsbt, psbt=psbt, descriptors=[signer2])
+        assert_equal(node.finalizepsbt(psbt)["complete"], False)
+
+    def test_taproot_final_witness_anyonecanpay(self):
+        self.log.info("Test that a finalized taproot input keeps the previous transaction only for ANYONECANPAY")
+        node = self.nodes[0]
+        signer, other = (2).to_bytes(32, "big"), (1).to_bytes(32, "big")
+        signer_pub, other_pub = compute_xonly_pubkey(signer)[0].hex(), compute_xonly_pubkey(other)[0].hex()
+        tree = "tr({},{{pk({}),pk({})}})"
+        for path, desc, pub_desc in [("Key path", "tr({})".format(bytes_to_wif(signer)), "tr({})".format(signer_pub)),
+                                     ("Script path", tree.format(H_POINT, bytes_to_wif(signer), other_pub), tree.format(H_POINT, signer_pub, other_pub))]:
+            desc = descsum_create(desc)
+            addr = node.deriveaddresses(descsum_create(pub_desc))[0]
+            for sighash, kept in [("ALL|ANYONECANPAY", True), ("DEFAULT", False)]:
+                self.log.info(f"{path}: signed with {sighash}, finalized, then processed again")
+                utxo = self.create_outpoints(node, outputs=[{addr: 1}])[0]
+                psbt = node.createpsbt([utxo], [{addr: 0.9999}])
+                res = node.descriptorprocesspsbt(psbt=psbt, descriptors=[desc], sighashtype=sighash)
+                assert_equal(res["complete"], True)
+                mod_psbt = PSBT.from_base64(res["psbt"])
+                assert PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE not in mod_psbt.i[0].map
+                mod_psbt.i[0].map[PSBT_IN_NON_WITNESS_UTXO] = bytes.fromhex(node.getrawtransaction(utxo["txid"]))
+                final = mod_psbt.to_base64()
+                for processed in [node.utxoupdatepsbt(final), node.descriptorprocesspsbt(psbt=final, descriptors=[desc], sighashtype=sighash)["psbt"]]:
+                    assert_equal("non_witness_utxo" in node.decodepsbt(processed)["inputs"][0], kept)
+
+        self.log.info("The last control block is 65 bytes and its last byte has 0x80, as a signature with ANYONECANPAY would")
+        control_block = bytes.fromhex(node.decodepsbt(res["psbt"])["inputs"][0]["final_scriptwitness"][-1])
+        assert_equal(len(control_block), 65)
+        assert control_block[-1] & 0x80
+
     def assert_change_type(self, psbtx, expected_type):
         """Assert that the given PSBT has a change output with the given type."""

         self.test_sighash_single()
         self.test_decodepsbt_long_sighash_type()
